Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the family relationships by conflating Adam’s stepfather (Ken Howard) with his maternal lineage, incorrectly pursuing Ken Howard’s father as the maternal grandfather. “Maternal grandfather” refers to the mother’s father (Margo Howard’s father), i.e., Ann Landers’ husband, Jules Lederer. This reflects a misalignment of terms/relationships and an erroneous inference path.
